label: GO after unrewarded common a1->S1 trial, at the very end of the episode (low value)
explanation: Fires only at GO steps, and only in the last ~10 trials of the episode (99.9% of activation mass at ep_trial 90-99; all of it where the value head is in its lowest bin, < 5.2). Within that window it is specific to the previous trial being a1 -> S1 (common) and unrewarded (prev_reward 0 holds 98% of mass, prev_action a1 94%, prev_common 0 holds none). That is, a common-unrewarded a1 trial, after which a model-based agent should switch. Low model value (< 4) works better than an ep_trial cutoff as the lateness term (dev F1 0.75 vs 0.69 for ep_trial >= 94; mass recall 0.91). The model often still chooses a1 here (model_act a1 holds 89% of mass), so adding the upcoming choice did not help. Magnitude rises with lateness/lower value: activations are weaker in early-late trials (ep_trial 90-93) and on the context trials of the window. Never fires at D1 or D2, before trial 80, after a rewarded trial, or after any a2 or rare trial. Uses only observed history plus the model-internal value, no future variables. Partial because the episode-end/value boundary is soft.
